question: by what percentage did the average wti crude oil benchmark decrease from 2007 to 2009?
reasoning: We need answer percentage decrease average WTI crude oil benchmark from 2007 to 2009. Document gives WTI crude oil (Dollars per barrel) 2009 $62.09, 2008 $99.75, 2007 $72.41. Decrease from 2007 to 2009: (72.41 - 62.09)/72.41 = 10.32/72.41 = 0.1425... = 14.25%. Need compute. Evidence: 62.09 | WTI crude oil benchmark 2009; 72.41 | WTI crude oil benchmark 2007. Program divide(subtract(72.41, 62.09), 72.41). Answer percentage maybe 14.25%.
raw_content:
<evidence>

72.41 | WTI crude oil (Dollars per barrel) 2007
</evidence>
<program>
